# QA API Automation Project

Automated API testing project using Playwright.

## Tools

- Node.js
- Playwright
- JavaScript

## API Tested

https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users

## Test Scenario

The test validates:

- API response status (200)
- Users list is returned
- JSON response contains the field "name"

## Run the tests

Install dependencies

npm install

Run tests

npx playwright test

View HTML report

npx playwright show-report
